ACTION=A2
Rationale: The ego vehicle is traveling at 50 kph toward a static obstacle located at x=17.0 meters. Given the relatively short distance to the hazard and high speed, maintaining speed (A0) would result in a collision, and harsher maneuvers like heavy braking or swerving without deceleration might be unsafe or unnecessary compared to controlled deceleration (A2) to approach or stop safely.
